name: @defjs/core
description: Define and execute typed HTTP, SSE, and WebSocket APIs.

scripts.bench:balancer: bun build src/balancer/balancer.bench.ts --target=bun --external=vitest --outdir=test-out/balancer-bench && vitest bench --config vitest.config.bench.ts test-out/balancer-bench --reporter=verbose --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.bench:struct: bun build src/struct/struct.bench.ts --target=bun --external=vitest --outdir=test-out/struct-bench && vitest bench --config vitest.config.bench.ts test-out/struct-bench --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.build: bun check --project tsconfig.build.json && bun --bun tsdown --config-loader native --config tsdown.config.ts
